title: reprodICU Native Dynamic Schema
description: A time-resolved value read straight out of a reprodICU table. Upstream's vars.json carries no `type` key, so the importer derives one from the entry's shape: `calculation` present -> derived_*, absent -> native_*; `dynamic: false` -> *_static, `dynamic` absent or true -> *_dynamic. The four reprodicu schemas encode that same rule, so a definition can only ever validate against the type it would be assigned.

path.description: The reprodICU table the values are read from (e.g. `timeseries_labs`)

column.description: The column of `path` holding this variable's values

is_struct.description: Whether the column is a polars struct (value + metadata such as the specimen system) rather than a plain value; the filter then addresses its fields with `.struct.field(...)`

filter.description: Polars predicate selecting this variable's rows, as an expression over `pl`

dynamic.description: Whether the variable is time-resolved. Absent means dynamic; upstream only ever writes this key out as `false`

unit.description: Unit of the extracted values, folded in from the source's units.json at import. Absent for dimensionless variables (scores, flags, categories)
